description: Statically scans a multi-agent delegation topology JSON object (graphTopologyJson, max 100,000 chars, with nodes and edges) via depth-bounded DFS (maxDepth 1–50, default 10) to detect cyclic delegation loops and untrusted-to-admin privilege paths. Free, deterministic, stateless check with no API key required; returns status FAILED on invalid JSON or empty graphs. Use for pre-deployment architecture checks; use systemores_analyze_trace_telemetry to detect runtime loops in live OpenTelemetry spans.

graphTopologyJson.description: JSON-serialized graph topology object (max 100,000 chars) containing 'nodes' ({ id, privilegeLevel: 'public'|'user'|'admin'|'system' }) and 'edges' ({ source, target }).

maxDepth.description: Maximum DFS traversal depth for cycle and privilege-path checks (clamped 1–50, default 10). Paths deeper than maxDepth are not traversed.

strictPrivilegeCheck.description: When true, flags any path from 'public'/'user' nodes to 'admin'/'system' nodes as a breach.

name: systemores_audit_agent_graph
title: Audit Multi-Agent Execution Topology
